title: ASMP Tweaks
description: Adds some tweaks for a Minecraft server called ASMP
body:
Adds some tweaks for a Minecraft server called ASMP

Tweaks:

-[Amarite](https://modrinth.com/mod/amarite) Sword and disks now works with Arsenal backslot and weapon racks

-Netherite shields from [Guarding](https://modrinth.com/mod/guarding) work with weapon racks and backslot

-[Aetherpunk](https://modrinth.com/mod/aetherpunkmod) mace now workswith Arsenal backslot and weapon racks

-Recipes for name tag, saddle, and lodestone

**0.2 Below Only**

-Recipes for an unificial Impaled port
